page.layout: One page of running text in one column. Printed page number at the top right. Running head at the top centre. Marginal notes run down the right margin, beside the last paragraph. A signature mark sits below the text.

main_text.l: V. Sed tamen hoc ego ferre malo, quam te hic no-
biscum vivere, neq; consequi ea posse, ad quae pleno
te cursu contendere iam audio.
VI. Quod vero in clarissimorum doctis-
simorum virorum familiaritatem iam venisti, dici non
potest, quanta me illud laetitia ac voluptate afficiat.
VII. Principibus, inquit ille, placuisse viris, non
infima laus est.
VIII. Et hac de causa Romanos, homines pru-
dentissimos, legimus filios suos doctorum ac prae-
stantium virorum vti consuetudine voluisse: vt eo-
rum, non tam fermone erudito, quam exemplis in-
formarentur: niterentur consiliis: praesentia, a sce-
leribus & peccatis deterrerentur.
IX. Itaq; operam da sedulo, ne quam apud tan-
tos viros collectam iam gratiam atq; benevolentiam
habes, aut negligentia in studiis, aut dissolutione in
vita ac moribus effundas.
X. Nihil, crede mihi, ex ista professione repor-
tare domum poteris, quod, vel iucundius nobis, vel
tibi honorificum atq; utile magis futurum sit.
Vt vero etiam responsionis, ad publi-
carum rerum nunciationes, imitatio in-s-
tituatur, 4. Bruti sumemus, in qua Cice-
ronis ille nunciatoriae epistolae de victo-
ria ab Antonio reportata, respondet. Est
enim egregia illa epistola & praecepta continet
pulcherrima, de adhibenda mode-

marginalia.note: Imitatio re-sponsionis ad epistolas nun-ciatorias de publicis re-bus instituen-tas.

page.notes: The printed page number reads "289", with the 9 in an old form. The running head is "NVNCIATORIIS:" with a colon, rendered here as NUNCIATORIIS. The first word of the last paragraph and the hyphenated words in the margin note are read from a small scan and may be imperfect. "victo-ria" is read from a ligature and is doubtful. The last word of the page is cut off by the hyphen, so the word continues on the next page. The margin note runs over seven short lines and is kept as one note. Words such as "hic" and "quam" may carry accents that are hard to see at this resolution.
